description.zh: 应用ID。通过控制台创建和查询，仅支持传单个ID。
description.en: Application ID. Created and queried via the console. Only a single ID is supported.

description.zh: 背景色RGB。默认是0（黑色）。计算公式为R+G×256+B×65536，R（红）、G（绿）、B（蓝）的取值：**0~255**。
description.en: Background color RGB. The default is 0 (black). The calculation formula is R + G × 256 + B × 65536. R (red), G (green), and B (blue) each range from **0 to 255**.

description.zh: 背景图片列表。
description.en: List of background images.

description.zh:
背景图片显示。取值：

- **0**（None）：不显示。
- **1**（Always）：总是显示。
description.en:
Background image display. Values:

- **0** (None): Not displayed.
- **1** (Always): Always displayed.

description.zh: 背景图片窗格高，归一化百分比。
description.en: Height of the background image pane, as a normalized percentage.

description.zh: 背景图片的HTTP或HTTPS地址。
description.en: HTTP or HTTPS address of the background image.

description.zh: 背景图片窗格宽，归一化百分比。
description.en: Width of the background image pane, as a normalized percentage.

description.zh: 背景图片坐标X，归一化百分比。
description.en: X coordinate of the background image, as a normalized percentage.

description.zh: 背景图片坐标Y，归一化百分比。
description.en: Y coordinate of the background image, as a normalized percentage.

description.zh: 背景图片叠放顺序，0为最底层，1层在0层之上，以此类推。
description.en: Z-order of the background image. 0 is the bottom layer, layer 1 is above layer 0, and so on.

description.zh: 时钟列表。
description.en: List of clocks.

Clock text color (RGB).

The calculation formula is `R + G × 256 + B × 65536`. R (red), G (green), and B (blue) each range from **0** to **255**.

description.zh: 时钟字体大小。字体合理范围**(0, 72]**。
description.en: Clock font size. Valid range: **(0, 72]**.

description.zh:
时钟字体类型，取值：

- **0**（默认值）：NOTO_SERIF_CJKSC_REGULAR
- **1**：ALIBABA_PUHUITI_REGULAR
- **2**：ALIBABA_PUHUITI_BOLD
- **3**：ALIBABA_PUHUITI_Heavy
- **4**：ALIBABA_PUHUITI_LIGHT
- **5**：ALIBABA_PUHUITI_MEDIUM
description.en:
Clock font type. Values:

- **0** (default): NOTO_SERIF_CJKSC_REGULAR
- **1**: ALIBABA_PUHUITI_REGULAR
- **2**: ALIBABA_PUHUITI_BOLD
- **3**: ALIBABA_PUHUITI_Heavy
- **4**: ALIBABA_PUHUITI_LIGHT
- **5**: ALIBABA_PUHUITI_MEDIUM

description.zh: 时钟坐标X，归一化百分比。
description.en: X coordinate of the clock, as a normalized percentage.

description.zh: 时钟坐标Y，归一化百分比。
description.en: Y coordinate of the clock, as a normalized percentage.

description.zh: 时钟叠放顺序，0为最底层，1层在0层之上，以此类推。
description.en: Z-order of the clock. 0 is the bottom layer, layer 1 is above layer 0, and so on.

description.zh: 延时停止录制的时间。单位：秒。默认值为**180**秒。
description.en: Delay time before stopping recording. Unit: seconds. Default value: **180** seconds.

description.zh: 录制的m3u8文件是否需要加上ts文件时间点。
description.en: Whether the recorded m3u8 file needs to include the timestamp of the ts file.

description.zh: 录制文件切割时长（大于等于1800）。单位：秒。
description.en: Recording file split duration (greater than or equal to 1800). Unit: seconds.

description.zh: 录制文件格式列表。
description.en: List of recording file formats.

description.zh:
录制事件HTTP回调地址。
> 此参数和MnsQueue必须输入其中某一个，不能两者都输入或都不输入。
description.en:
HTTP callback URL for recording events.
> One and only one of this parameter and MnsQueue must be provided; you cannot provide both or neither.

description.zh: 布局ID数据列表。
description.en: List of layout ID data.

description.zh: 编码选项，请参见下文中的MediaEncode枚举值。
description.en: Encoding option. See the MediaEncode enumeration values below.

description.zh:
录制事件回调消息队列。

> 此参数和HttpCallbackUrl必须输入其中某一个，不能两者都输入或都不输入。
description.en:
Message queue for recording event callbacks.

> One and only one of this parameter and HttpCallbackUrl must be provided; you cannot provide both or neither.

description.zh: 录制配置模板名称。
description.en: Recording configuration template name.

description.zh:
录制文件存储的OSS bucket。

> 目前仅支持上海区域OSS bucket。
description.en:
OSS bucket where the recording files are stored.

> Currently, only OSS buckets in the Shanghai region are supported.

description.zh:
录制文件命名规则。

> 为确保录制的文件名称唯一，目前录制文件的命名规则为record/{AppId}/{ChannelId_TaskId}/{EscapedStartTime}_{EscapedEndTime}。
description.en:
Naming rule for recording files.

> To ensure that recording file names are unique, the current naming rule is record/{AppId}/{ChannelId_TaskId}/{EscapedStartTime}_{EscapedEndTime}.

description.zh:
任务计费配置，根据您的不同设置，进行收费。请参见下文中的TaskProfile枚举值。

> - 编码选项MediaEncode的分辨率需要小于等于TaskProfile的分辨率。
- 布局最大窗格数需要小于等于TaskProfile的输入路数。
description.en:
Task billing configuration. Charges vary based on your settings. See the TaskProfile enumeration values below.

> - The resolution of the encoding option MediaEncode must be less than or equal to the resolution of TaskProfile.
- The maximum number of panes in a layout must be less than or equal to the number of input streams of TaskProfile.

description.zh: 水印列表。
description.en: List of watermarks.

description.zh: 水印透明度。0.0表示透明，1.0表示完全不透明。
description.en: Watermark transparency. 0.0 means transparent, 1.0 means fully opaque.

description.zh:
水印显示。取值：

- **0**（None）：不显示。
- **1**（Always）：总是显示。
description.en:
Watermark display. Values:

- **0** (None): Not displayed.
- **1** (Always): Always displayed.

description.zh: 水印窗格高，归一化百分比。
description.en: Height of the watermark pane, as a normalized percentage.

description.zh: 水印的HTTP或HTTPS地址。
description.en: HTTP or HTTPS address of the watermark.

description.zh: 水印窗格宽，归一化百分比。
description.en: Width of the watermark pane, as a normalized percentage.

description.zh: 水印坐标X，归一化百分比。
description.en: X coordinate of the watermark, as a normalized percentage.

description.zh: 水印坐标Y，归一化百分比。
description.en: Y coordinate of the watermark, as a normalized percentage.

description.zh: 水印叠放顺序，0为最底层，1层在0层之上，以此类推。
description.en: Z-order of the watermark. 0 is the bottom layer, layer 1 is above layer 0, and so on.

descriptions.zh:
# 使用说明
本接口用于添加录制配置模板。例如：添加录制配置模板时，您可以配置录制规格、编码选项等参数。
# QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为100次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。更多信息，请参见[QPS限制](~~341645~~)。
descriptions.en:
# Usage Notes
This interface is used to add a recording configuration template. For example, when adding a recording configuration template, you can configure parameters such as recording specifications and encoding options.
# QPS Limits
The single-user QPS limit for this interface is 100 calls per second. Exceeding this limit will result in throttling, which may affect your business. Please call the interface reasonably. For more information, see [QPS Limits](~~341645~~).
